n2def8dab55.headline: Foreign Remittances from Saudi Arabia Reach Highest Level Since 2022
n2def8dab55.summary: Foreign remittances from Saudi Arabia rose 14% in 2024 to SAR144 billion ($38.4 billion), the highest level since 2022, according to Saudi Central Bank data.
n2def8dab55.why: Remittance flows reflect migrant worker income and affect the balance of payments and domestic consumption in source countries.

nc746f2aacc.headline: The new safety regulation that's killing multiple models in Australia
nc746f2aacc.summary: A new Australian government regulation on autonomous emergency braking has led multiple auto brands to discontinue certain models, according to the report.
nc746f2aacc.why: Vehicle safety regulation affects carmakers' model ranges, compliance costs and sales in the Australian market.

n45d6525097.headline: Bills will keep rising without switch to home-grown power, Miliband suggests
n45d6525097.summary: UK Energy Secretary Ed Miliband suggested bills will keep rising without a switch to home-grown power, saying the UK is in the grip of markets run by petro-states.
n45d6525097.why: Household and industrial energy bills in the UK depend heavily on global gas and oil prices. Policy choices on domestic generation shape long-run energy costs and investment in the power sector.

n886a153d31.headline: In the news today: StatCan to release January jobs report
n886a153d31.summary: Statistics Canada is set to release its January jobs report, the national labour force data for the month.
n886a153d31.why: Canada's monthly labour force survey shapes expectations for Bank of Canada interest rate decisions and the Canadian dollar. Employment data is a key gauge of economic momentum.

n6b51952e40.headline: Vedanta seeks $1bn in debt financing for Konkola Copper Mines in Zambia
n6b51952e40.summary: Vedanta Resources is reportedly seeking approximately $1bn in debt financing to fund development of its Konkola Copper Mines in Zambia.
n6b51952e40.why: Vedanta is a diversified natural resources group, and Konkola is a major copper asset whose development depends on financing.

ndebf1f31f2.headline: GrafTech Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Results
ndebf1f31f2.summary: GrafTech reported fourth quarter and full year 2024 results, highlighting volume growth, cost reductions and working capital management. It also completed financing transactions to bolster liquidity and extend debt maturities.
ndebf1f31f2.why: GrafTech makes graphite electrodes used in electric arc steel furnaces, so its results reflect steel industry demand.

n2cc6102f30.headline: Fitch Ratings acknowledges Pakistan’s progress on economic stability
n2cc6102f30.summary: Fitch Ratings said Pakistan has continued to make headway restoring economic stability and rebuilding external buffers. The statement was issued on Friday.
n2cc6102f30.why: Fitch is one of the major credit rating agencies, and its assessments influence sovereign borrowing costs. External buffers such as reserves matter for emerging-market investors.

n46bdb9244b.headline: RBI’s response apt albeit rising dollar complicating matters, says former governor Subbarao
n46bdb9244b.summary: Former Reserve Bank of India governor Subbarao said the RBI's response is apt, though a rising dollar complicates matters. He said the dollar is likely to stay strong for some time.
n46bdb9244b.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets monetary policy and manages the rupee, so its response to dollar strength affects Indian rates, inflation and currency stability.

n5838d8793d.headline: Cyprus Business Now: airport expansion, property sales, inflation, unemployment
n5838d8793d.summary: The environment department approved expansion plans for Larnaca and Paphos international airports, following a December 2024 agreement extending Hermes Airports' management until 2033.
n5838d8793d.why: Airport expansion drives tourism capacity and infrastructure investment, which are central to Cyprus's economy.

n9e84ac01d5.headline: Croatia keen on expanding ties with Qatar in various fields
n9e84ac01d5.summary: Croatia's minister of economy and sustainable development, Ante Šušnjar, expressed the country's interest in expanding ties with Qatar in various fields.
n9e84ac01d5.why: Gulf states such as Qatar are major sovereign investors, so new bilateral economic links can open trade and investment channels for European economies.

n17c6df657f.headline: Apartments drive Cyprus sales, rental markets
n17c6df657f.summary: Cyprus apartment values rose 1.3% and holiday apartments 0.9% in the fourth quarter, a survey by Ask Wire found. Warehouses fell 2.3%, retail spaces 1.7%, and houses, offices and villas 0.3%.
n17c6df657f.why: Property prices and rental markets are key indicators of household wealth, bank lending exposure and tourism-linked demand in small economies such as Cyprus.

n05fe5a5031.headline: Breakingviews - New banking Ops in Italy may be more than a sideshow
n05fe5a5031.summary: Breakingviews says BPER, valued at 9.8 billion euros on the stock market, has launched a 4.3 billion euro transaction. The move is part of a series of large Italian bank mergers.
n05fe5a5031.why: BPER Banca is a listed Italian lender, and bank consolidation in Italy affects capital allocation, competition and shareholder returns in the sector.

n6618f9f753.headline: Oil and Gas Traders to Seek Tariffs Exemptions from China for US Imports
n6618f9f753.summary: Oil and gas traders are likely to seek waivers from Beijing over tariffs that China plans to impose on US crude. The planned Chinese tariffs target US energy imports.
n6618f9f753.why: China is a major importer of crude oil, and tariffs on US barrels shift global crude flows and price spreads between US and other grades.

n01d37fdc27.headline: 2 obscure clean energy metals are caught in the crosshairs of the US-China trade war
n01d37fdc27.summary: A Chinese export ban has put gallium and germanium at the center of the US-China trade dispute. The article asks whether America can source the metals from Canada or whether tariffs will get in the way.
n01d37fdc27.why: Gallium and germanium are critical inputs for semiconductors, infrared optics and solar cells, so supply restrictions can ripple through electronics and defense supply chains.

n39d8feddd0.headline: Henkel:  sale of private labels in America
n39d8feddd0.summary: Henkel announced it has signed an agreement to sell its private label business in North America. The sum was not disclosed.
n39d8feddd0.why: Henkel is a German consumer goods and adhesives group, and divestitures like this reshape its portfolio and capital allocation.

impacts.name: Henkel
impacts.why: Henkel is the seller of the North American private label business.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n9473538f39.headline: Did Trump get to deal with the first Dutch disease in the U.S.?
n9473538f39.summary: The article argues that the United States recorded its largest trade deficit in history in 2024. It frames tariffs or currency devaluation as the policy dilemma facing the Trump administration.
n9473538f39.why: Trade deficits and currency policy affect the dollar, interest rates, and the outlook for tariffs on US trading partners.

nd62acd0770.headline: EU Weighing Lifting Syria Sanctions
nd62acd0770.summary: The European Union is discussing a deal to partially suspend several sanctions on Syria's energy industry. The plan includes scrapping bans on importing crude from the country.
nd62acd0770.why: Sanctions determine which energy exports can be legally traded, affecting oil flows and the commercial access of producers.

nd2656a30b1.headline: Global cost of renewables to continue falling in 2025 as China extends manufacturing lead
nd2656a30b1.summary: BloombergNEF expects clean power technology costs to fall a further 2-11% in 2025, extending the record decline of 2024 as China extends its manufacturing lead.
nd2656a30b1.why: BloombergNEF is a research provider tracking energy transition costs, which shape investment in solar, wind and storage.

na5f29cfd5a.headline: Trump's tariffs on China bite US bargain-hunting online shoppers
na5f29cfd5a.summary: US bargain-hunting online shoppers are facing duties and fees on orders from overseas sellers, with DHL requesting payment tied to a fashion order from Australia. The charges follow new tariffs on Chinese goods.
na5f29cfd5a.why: Tariffs on Chinese imports raise costs for US retailers and consumers, and shifts in cross-border e-commerce affect logistics and online retail companies.

n0261c2720f.headline: Foreign funds drag QSE index down; M-cap melts QR2.44bn
n0261c2720f.summary: The Qatar Stock Exchange closed the week weaker as foreign funds pulled money out, with market capitalisation down QR2.44bn. US tariff policy and a proposal on Gaza weighed on regional bourses.
n0261c2720f.why: The Qatar Stock Exchange is the main venue for Qatari listed companies, and foreign flows and regional geopolitics influence its performance.

n6a14d5fd0b.headline: Trump’s Iran Sanctions Hit 3 Ships Involved In China Trade
n6a14d5fd0b.summary: President Donald Trump's first sanctions against Iran target three vessels carrying Iranian crude oil to China. The measures apply to ships involved in China trade.
n6a14d5fd0b.why: Sanctions on Iranian oil shipments affect global crude supply and the tanker and shipping companies that move oil between Iran and China.

n55e140ff6a.headline: Bed Bath & Beyond Stores Are Coming Back Nationwide
n55e140ff6a.summary: Bed Bath & Beyond stores are coming back nationwide, with the first location slated to open sometime this year. More locations are expected to follow.
n55e140ff6a.why: Bed Bath & Beyond was a major US home goods retailer that went bankrupt in 2023, and its return signals a revived retail brand.

n2450186ed5.headline: Honeywell Automation India reports lacklustre profit growth on slowing demand
n2450186ed5.summary: Honeywell Automation India reported weak third-quarter profit growth, hurt by slowing infrastructure demand amid sluggish economic growth, according to the source.
n2450186ed5.why: Honeywell Automation India is the Indian unit of the US industrial technology group Honeywell, supplying automation and control systems to industry.

na1b70ab492.headline: What does 'stagflation' mean for the labour market?
na1b70ab492.summary: Latest forecasts on UK economic growth and inflation raise questions about whether the labour market could face stagflation. The article examines implications for employment.
na1b70ab492.why: Stagflation combines weak growth with high inflation, which squeezes wages, employment and central bank policy choices.

n6349aa5dd1.headline: Average house prices rise to record high of £299k – Halifax
n6349aa5dd1.summary: Halifax reports the average UK house price reached a record £299,138, though annual growth eased to 3% in January from 3.4% in December.
n6349aa5dd1.why: House prices drive household wealth, mortgage lending and consumer spending, and are a key gauge of the UK economy.

n214b4a8e8e.headline: Freelancer total drops for second month as tax crackdown starts
n214b4a8e8e.summary: The number of registered freelancers in the Netherlands fell by 4,000 in January, per Chamber of Commerce figures. The drop was expected after the government's crackdown on sham self-employment took effect.
n214b4a8e8e.why: Changes in self-employment rules affect labour supply, employer costs and the flexible workforce across the Dutch economy.

nb3f36e13ad.headline: Markets give up early gains! Nifty ends below 23,600, Sensex down almost 200 points
nb3f36e13ad.summary: Indian equity markets reversed early gains despite a Reserve Bank of India rate cut. The Nifty closed below 23,600 while the Sensex fell almost 200 points.
nb3f36e13ad.why: The Nifty 50 and Sensex are the benchmark indices of the National Stock Exchange and BSE in India, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
nb3f36e13ad.why_moved: Indian equities gave up early gains in the session despite a Reserve Bank of India rate cut.

n0be0489e5f.headline: 5 banks introduce new mortgage rules - from Barclays to Santander and Nationwide
n0be0489e5f.summary: Five UK banks, including Barclays, Santander and Nationwide, introduced new mortgage rules. The changes follow the Bank of England's quarter-point base rate cut announced on February 6.
n0be0489e5f.why: Mortgage pricing from major UK lenders transmits Bank of England rate decisions to households and the housing market.

n60c7df5fa4.headline: Guardant Health Announces Debt Exchange Transactions
n60c7df5fa4.summary: Guardant Health entered into privately negotiated exchange agreements with certain holders of its outstanding debt on February 6, 2025. The company announced the transactions.
n60c7df5fa4.why: Guardant Health is a US precision oncology company, and debt exchanges change its capital structure and balance sheet obligations.

n8bd87704a7.headline: Senate confirms Project 2025 architect to lead powerful White House budget office
n8bd87704a7.summary: The Senate confirmed Russell Vought as White House budget director on Thursday night. Vought is described as a Project 2025 architect.
n8bd87704a7.why: The Office of Management and Budget oversees federal budget preparation and spending policy, shaping fiscal decisions.

n0d141f1170.headline: Gold prices in Saudi Arabia drops – 07 February 2025
n0d141f1170.summary: The price of 24-karat gold in Saudi Arabia declined to 3,955 Saudi riyals per tola on Friday, February 7, according to forex.pk.
n0d141f1170.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a benchmark for investors seeking protection against inflation and currency risk. Local gold prices track international bullion prices converted into local currency.

n73e3acdf32.headline: China criticises US ‘coercion’ as Panama declines to renew infrastructure deal
n73e3acdf32.summary: Panama decided not to renew an infrastructure deal, a move seen as a concession to the US over the Panama Canal. China criticised US coercion in response.
n73e3acdf32.why: The Panama Canal is a key global shipping route, so changes to infrastructure arrangements there matter for trade flows and geopolitical competition.

n63fb85fffe.headline: Vietnam braces for fallout from US tariffs on Chinese goods
n63fb85fffe.summary: Vietnam's prime minister told the Cabinet to prepare for the possibility of a world trade war this year. The directive comes as US tariffs on Chinese goods take effect.
n63fb85fffe.why: Vietnam is a major export manufacturing hub, so shifts in US-China tariffs can redirect trade and investment flows through its economy.

nf111be92bd.headline: Trump Brings Back 'Maximum Pressure' -- And Offers Iran An Olive Branch
nf111be92bd.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has reportedly returned to a 'maximum pressure' campaign on Iran while saying he wants a 'verified nuclear peace agreement' with Tehran.
nf111be92bd.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and U.S. sanctions and nuclear diplomacy affect global crude supply expectations and Middle East risk premia.

n10dd133eae.headline: Australian Market Treads Back In To The Red In Mid-market
n10dd133eae.summary: The Australian stock market slipped in choppy mid-market trading on Friday, snapping a three-session winning streak. The move followed mixed cues from Wall Street overnight.
n10dd133eae.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index, tracking the largest listed companies on the Australian Securities Exchange.

nac907f1741.headline: Interest rates: Why have they been cut and what does it mean?
nac907f1741.summary: The Bank of England has lowered interest rates, signaling monetary easing to support economic growth.
nac907f1741.why: Interest rate decisions influence borrowing costs, inflation, and economic activity in the UK.

nc01c1035a8.headline: Time to walk the talk on climate action
nc01c1035a8.summary: Pakistan's International Climate Change Conference begins, highlighting the country's focus on climate action and environmental policies.
nc01c1035a8.why: Climate policies and international conferences can impact energy, agriculture, and related sectors.

n709f827a90.headline: Apple’s China focus thrusts it into center of geopolitical fight
n709f827a90.summary: Apple relies on China as its main manufacturing hub and the US as its largest market, making it vulnerable to escalating geopolitical conflicts.
n709f827a90.why: Apple is a major technology company with significant supply chain and market exposure in China and the US.
n709f827a90.why_moved: Geopolitical tensions between US and China threaten Apple's manufacturing and market operations.

n7b857747fc.headline: RBI MPC meeting at a glance: Your one-stop guide for all key decisions
n7b857747fc.summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced a 25 basis point cut in the repo rate during its latest MPC meeting, aiming to support economic growth.
n7b857747fc.why: The repo rate influences borrowing costs, impacting consumer and business credit, and signals monetary policy stance.
n7b857747fc.why_moved: Lowering the repo rate reduces borrowing costs, potentially stimulating economic activity and influencing inflation.
